attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Determine if corporation must file Kentucky corporate tax return. Checks for physical presence or economic nexus (post-Wayfair).

condition_details.condition_comment: Meets economic nexus threshold ($100K gross receipts or 200 transactions); result.ky_gross_receipts is greater than or equal to result.ky_economic_nexus_threshold

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kentucky state-specific additions and subtractions to federal taxable income. KY requires addback of federal interest income and IRC 199A deduction, with subtraction of KY municipal bond interest and dividends from KY corporations.

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kentucky state additions and subtractions; Calculate state-specific income adjustments
action_details.action_dsl: set ky_result.state_additions = 0.0; if ky_result.us_interest_income != 0.0 then set ky_result.state_additions = ky_result.state_additions + ky_result.us_interest_income; endif set ky_result.state_subtractions = 0.0; if ky_result.municipal_interest != 0.0 then set ky_result.state_subtractions = ky_result.state_subtractions + ky_result.municipal_interest; endif if ky_result.dividends_from_ky_corps != 0.0 then set ky_result.state_subtractions = ky_result.state_subtractions + ky_result.dividends_from_ky_corps; endif add (("Kentucky additions: $" + string value of (ky_result.state_additions)) + ", subtractions: $") + string value of (ky_result.state_subtractions) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: 0.0 cvd /ky_result.state_additions xdef { ky_result.state_additions ky_result.us_interest_income f+ cvd /ky_result.state_additions xdef } {} ky_result.us_interest_income 0.0 f== not ifelse 0.0 cvd /ky_result.state_subtractions xdef { ky_result.state_subtractions ky_result.municipal_interest f+ cvd /ky_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} ky_result.municipal_interest 0.0 f== not ifelse { ky_result.state_subtractions ky_result.dividends_from_ky_corps f+ cvd /ky_result.state_subtractions xdef } {} ky_result.dividends_from_ky_corps 0.0 f== not ifelse "Kentucky additions: $" ky_result.state_additions cvs strconcat ", subtractions: $" strconcat ky_result.state_subtractions cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculate Kentucky corporate income tax. Applies Kentucky flat rate (4.5%) to apportioned and adjusted taxable income.

condition_details.condition_comment: Has positive taxable income; result.ky_apportioned_income is greater than 0

action_details.action_comment: Calculate Kentucky corporate tax (flat rate 4.5%); Apply Kentucky 4.5% flat rate
action_details.action_dsl: set ky_result.taxable_income = the maximum of (ky_result.apportioned_income + ky_result.state_additions - ky_result.state_subtractions) and (0.0); set ky_result.tax_liability = the maximum of (ky_result.taxable_income * ky_result.corp_tax_rate - ky_result.state_credits) and (0.0); set ky_result.refund_or_owed = ky_result.estimated_payments - ky_result.tax_liability; add "Kentucky taxable income: $" + string value of (ky_result.taxable_income) to job.audit_trail; add "Kentucky tax liability (4.5%): $" + string value of (ky_result.tax_liability) to job.audit_trail;
action_details.action_postfix: ky_result.apportioned_income ky_result.state_additions ky_result.state_subtractions f- f+ 0.0 fmax cvd /ky_result.taxable_income xdef ky_result.taxable_income ky_result.corp_tax_rate fmul ky_result.state_credits f- 0.0 fmax cvd /ky_result.tax_liability xdef ky_result.estimated_payments ky_result.tax_liability f- cvd /ky_result.refund_or_owed xdef "Kentucky taxable income: $" ky_result.taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto "Kentucky tax liability (4.5%): $" ky_result.tax_liability cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

action_details.action_comment: No taxable income - no tax liability
